development.scope: stored identities/counts/Adam/tensors and available raw outcomes; no trajectory/inference replay

earlier_screen.scope: stored identities/counts/Adam/tensor digests and raw paired statistics; no trajectory replay

seed_scan.scope: recursive stored JSON ranges and raw recorded seeds; excludes this final run; no claim about unrecorded work

criteria.primary: BOTH frozen model seeds: assisted RL-WP win-score95% CI lower bound >0.5.
criteria.secondary: Separately report assisted RL-Point on both models; replicated secondary criterion requires BOTH lower bounds >0.5. Points remain secondary and never replace win-score criteria.
criteria.interpretation: Pair bootstrap conditional on each fixed model; not exact coverage or a claim about all possible training seeds. The four evaluations share10000 deal seeds, not40000 independent deals. Canonical model remains the prespecified first training seed. No reranking or pooling.

final_protocol.stop_rule: Exactlyfour evaluations x10000 duplicate pairs (80000 played matches). No training, adaptation, extension, early strength stopping or model selection on final outcomes. Failure aborts owned workers and retains artifacts. Audit all raw results before a conclusion; preserve failures. Concurrent decision timings are not isolated latency benchmarks.

feature_compatibility.scope: Independent replay of random corpus; cached-state hashes; reference masks/guards/public observations; stored feature digest equality; independent raw-logit and latency arithmetic. Inference and timing measurements are not independently rerun.

search_replication.note: Independent statistics helpers import no koikoi code. All1000 rows retained; paired development intervals do not establish final public superiority. Same deals across training seeds are not additional independent deal samples.

search_confirmation.note: Both fixed endpoints required. Statistics recomputed from paired raw records without production helpers. Same deals across models are not additional independent samples. Development results do not replace final testing.

selected_world_diagnostic.note: Checks stored root statistics and counts, not an independent particle-level replay. Conditional diagnostic roots are not strength samples.

supported_world_diagnostic.note: Independent reconstruction of every world stream and raw utility statistics/hash/count audit. Not independent replay of every future trajectory. Production self-play and four serial trajectories checked per group by runner. No aggregate independent-root CI or strength claim.

scale.note: New research12 budget achieved; public-superiority and final-testing gates remain unachieved.

final.scope: frozen identities, accounting, recorded work, raw pairs and independently recomputed statistics; no trajectory/inference replay

audit.scope: artifact identities, fixed cached sampling, raw timing/action accounting and independent descriptive statistics; not an independent timing or inference rerun; project workload absence is observed at pass boundaries only

scope: transcription of audited artifacts, not a new statistical or trajectory audit
